title: Why City Lights Are Erasing The Night Sky
hook: Your Milky Way vanished -- 80 percent of us can't see it.
closing: The stars didn't leave. The lights just won.
question: When did you last see real darkness?

segments.say: Night skies have grown 22 percent dimmer over just the last decade.
80 percent of people live under skies too bright to see the Milky Way.
In Chad, 78 percent still see pristine skies; in Singapore, almost none.
